theory.limits: Derivative singularity, reversed/near-zero forward speed, nonfinite feedback or inconsistent current native/card actuator metadata refuse commands. Incidence circle, asymmetric stops and genuine absent roll authority are explicit. R77M is a finite local search, not a proven global nonlinear optimum. Frozen operating point/diagonal inertia are reduced-order assumptions.
theory.delta: 22 cascade configurations; PL10 actuator-aware pole-assigned feedback; R77M bounded operating-point prediction/search. Every model retains its exact response/lag/rate/incidence values, source basis and native derivative/mixer binding.
theory.state: Load-feedback cascade and actuator-aware command laws are stateless; actual plant/actuator state comes from the same native sample. Operating-point solver reads actual channel lag/rate history, physical fin positions, malfunction state and current force/moment curves. No hidden integral state or synthetic force application.
theory.io: SI signed BODY derivative matrix, current CG moment/inertia, actual force/fin feedback, own incidence/rates/speed, guidance specific force and gravity. Output only normalized channels; native FCS/flight plant alone applies forces.
theory.discretization: Cascade response times are continuous engineering bandwidth choices evaluated at each native command tick. PL10 explicitly places three continuous poles including finite actuator lag. R77M predicts native Tustin/rate/stops over actual substeps, tests bounded active faces with pivoted QR and bounded backtracking; its cost is evaluated with the actual predictor.
theory.uncertainty: All three mechanisms are distinct equivalence cohorts. PL10 and R77M cannot be admitted by a cascade-only reference. Synthetic 100kg/500m/s benchmark is a numerical method fixture, never that missile physical plant. Actual variant derivatives/mass/geometry remain separately bound XML/native inputs.
